description: This file implements a class `lssFile` for handling secure stream file transactions within the libwebsockets framework. It includes functions for reading from and writing to files, managing the state of the stream, and handling lifecycle events such as destruction.

classes.name: lssFile
classes.description: A class managing secure stream file transactions, including file I/O operations and state management.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes data to the file, opens the file if not already open, and handles closing on end of message or error.

methods.name: lssFile
methods.description: Constructor initializes the secure stream file object with context, URI, path, and other parameters.

methods.name: ~lssFile
methods.description: Destructor closes the file if it is open.
